criteria.detail: 598/598 C functions,174344/174232 bytes,645 total functions, three fragments, R007/R011 treatment, data partitions and38 local links agree with current metadata. findings.title: Raw record-field accesses remain where named layouts already exist
findings.observed: The player callback consumes render_frame as char *direction and selects motion bytes [1]/[2], although the caller passes render_frame and the Earthling callback already uses motion_x/motion_y. The heterogeneous ship-display block still selects known frame/notice fields through [0]/[4]. FM ownership uses raw 0xd/0x13 field displacements despite MUSIC_PRIORITY/MUSIC_SELECTED equates. These retained forms have no corresponding representation qualification in the ledger.
findings.required_fix: Use the named frame fields through the real frame type and migrate both wrappers; model or explicitly name the distinct ship-display fields without numeric record offsets; use the existing music-field equates. If a typed spelling truly cannot match, supply the concrete matching evidence, local MATCHING QUALIFICATION and accepting ledger review rather than silently retaining an unexplained raw record view.

findings.title: Known semantic IDs remain unexplained numeric literals
findings.observed: Player ghost states are tested as5/6 even though PLAYER_ANIM_GHOST/PLAYER_ANIM_LAST_LIFE_GHOST exist. Large-item placement uses terrain32 and item83/81 instead of TERRAIN_SINKING/ITEM_HURT_HAZARD/ITEM_LARGE_BASE. Elevator state3/8/11/13 protocols remain unnamed; the elevator guide expressly acknowledges the absence of constants while describing their roles. These are domain IDs, not genuinely numeric coordinates/counts or disclosed compiler requirements.
findings.required_fix: Use the existing domain constants at the identified consumers and give the evidenced elevator protocol states named constants while retaining byte storage. Apply the same naming to their affected callsites and keep uncertain identities explicitly uncertain rather than inventing depicted content names.

findings.title: The required MATCHING QUALIFICATION marker is not applied to all recorded coaxing
findings.observed: All165 ledger rows have accepting-review references, and the referenced finalized reviews pass. However, at least seven positively documented retained source constraints have only older prose comments and no MATCHING QUALIFICATION marker: Q008,Q016,Q059,Q062,Q120,Q123,Q127. This is a searchable local-marker coverage gap, not a claim that these forms lack a ledger entry or that the historical compiler experiments have been disproved.
findings.required_fix: Standardize the existing constraint comments to the required MATCHING QUALIFICATION prefix, precisely covering the retained operation/declaration; sweep the other ledgered constraints for the same omission. Preserve accepting-review provenance and do not relabel observation-only register hints as proven necessity.

findings.title: README quick start requests REV00 without importing its required original
findings.observed: The README imports only the RevA/REV02 dump and immediately instructs building REV00. The importer identifies and writes just one revision; build first loads that selected revision original, and load raises when its orig file is absent. RESUME correctly imports both dumps.
findings.inference: [INFERENCE] On a fresh checkout following only the displayed commands, the REV00 build stops for missing orig/rev00/baserom.bin. The error path was inspected, not executed.
findings.required_fix: Add the REV00 dump import before its build, as RESUME already does, or explicitly make that command conditional on importing the second dump. Retain truthful latest-accepted c033 provenance while c034 is under review. Also do not leave STATUS/RESUME saying remaining readability is optional until F001-F003 are resolved.
